CREATE TABLE template_entry_item ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, day_template_id BIGINT NOT NULL, entry_template_id BIGINT NOT NULL, position INTEGER NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT uk_entry_item_pos UNIQUE (day_template_id, position), CONSTRAINT fk_entry_item_day_tpl FOREIGN KEY (day_template_id) REFERENCES day_template (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT fk_entry_item_entry_tpl FOREIGN KEY (entry_template_id) REFERENCES diary_entry_template (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT );
CREATE INDEX idx_entry_item_day_tpl ON template_entry_item (day_template_id); CREATE INDEX idx_entry_item_entry_tpl ON template_entry_item (entry_template_id);
